title: Billing and Coding: Eculizumab, and Biosimilars: EPYSQLI®-eculizumab-aagh, and  BKEMV™-eculizumab-aeeb

codes.1: HCPCS code J1300 should be used to report eculizumab, effective 01/01/2025 through 03/31/2025. HCPCS code J1300 has been deleted and replaced by HCPCS codes J1299, effective 4/1/2025. HCPCS code Q5139 should be used to report eculizumab-aeeb, effective 01/01/2025 through 03/31/2025. HCPCS code Q5139 has been deleted and replaced by HCPCS codes Q5152, and should be used to report eculizumab-aeeb, effective 4/1/2025. HCPCS code Q5151 has been added and should be used to report eculixumab-aagh, effective 4/1/2025. Effective for dates of service on or after 05/01/2021, the administration of eculizumab should be billed using the intravenous infusion administration codes (Refer to article A58620 - Billing and Coding: Complex Drug Administration Coding).
